<1>En clair</1> Aucun cookie et aucun tr: <1>In plain terms</1> No cookies and no trackers: there is nothing to accept or refuse.
Vérifié de deux façons. Dans le code liv: Checked in two ways. First in the shipped code (script <1>outils/preuve-confidentialite.cjs</1>, run at every check): no page sets a cookie (no <2>document.cookie</2>, no <3>Set-Cookie</3> header in the configuration or in the sending function), no page loads a script, stylesheet, font or image from another site, and no analytics or advertising tool is present; the font is hosted on the site. Then in a browser, on October 1, 2026, on 17 pages before any action and then during the main uses (calculator, map, lists, “I have it”, Léo, Contact draft, alert): 0 cookies, no <4>IndexedDB</4> database, no cache and no <5>service worker</5>, no request to another site. The only exit from the site is submitting the home page alert: when you click “Notify me” after checking the box, your browser goes to Brevo’s page.
Le stockage du navigateur décrit plus ha: The browser storage described above is used only for the features you use and is written only after an action on your part: it is exempt from consent (Article 82 of the French Data Protection Act, the loi Informatique et Libertés; the CNIL’s page <1>“Cookies and trackers: what does the law say?”</1>, its guidelines No. 2020-091 and its recommendation No. 2020-092 of September 17, 2020, consulted on October 1, 2026). That is why the site shows no banner: there is nothing to accept or refuse, and a banner with no trackers behind it would protect nothing.
En t’inscrivant à l’alerte, tu arrives s: When you sign up for the alert, you land on a Brevo page, which applies its own rules. Opening a link to another site (Rockstar, gtadb.org…) takes you off Leonidakit.
<1>En clair</1> Le site dit toujours d’o: <1>In plain terms</1> The site always says where a piece of information comes from and how reliable it is; the calculations are estimates.
Chaque information porte un statut (offi: Each piece of information has a status (official, seen in media, community identification, series benchmark, to be confirmed) explained on the <1>About</1> page. A price or number from the game stays “to be confirmed” as long as Rockstar has not published anything.
Les résultats du calculateur dépendent d: The calculator’s results depend on the numbers you enter: they are estimates, with no guarantee that they match the game. Léo only says what the site says, with the source page; Léo can be wrong, and every answer has a link to report it.
Les liens vers d’autres sites sont fourn: Links to other sites are provided so you can check information; their content is the responsibility of their publishers. Found an error? <1>Report it</1>: it gets fixed as soon as a source allows.
<1>En clair</1> Le site est pensé pour l: <1>In plain terms</1> The site is designed for keyboard use and reduced motion, but has not undergone an official audit.
Ce qui est fait et vérifié par des scrip: What is done and checked by scripts with every version: full keyboard navigation with visible focus, text contrast at AA level (WCAG standards) on the checked pages, support for the “Reduce motion” setting, alt text for images, accessible names for form fields, announced error messages.
Ce qui n’est pas fait : aucun audit selo: What is not done: no audit against the RGAA (the French accessibility standard), and therefore no compliance statement; no testing with an actual screen reader. If something blocks you, <1>write to us</1> describing your setup.
